definitions.gloss: short trip; excursion; day trip; outing
definitions.explanation: A brief trip or outing, typically lasting a day or a weekend, as opposed to a longer vacation. Often used for casual leisure outings to nearby destinations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{小旅行|しょうりょこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went on a short trip over the weekend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小旅行|しょうりょこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧きた。
examples.english: I took a day trip and visited a hot spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{取|と}れない→取れる：02376_toreru⟧⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧、{近場|ちかば}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小旅行|しょうりょこう}なら⟦{気軽|きがる}→気軽：06865_kigaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: I can't take a long vacation, but I can easily enjoy a short trip to somewhere nearby.

notes:
USAGE: {小旅行|しょうりょこう} emphasizes the brevity of the trip. It is a compound of {小|しょう} (small, short) and ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧ (trip, travel).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小旅行|しょうりょこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go on a short trip
- ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小旅行|しょうりょこう}: a day trip
- ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小旅行|しょうりょこう}: a weekend getaway
- {小旅行|しょうりょこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: to enjoy an excursion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小旅行|しょうりょこう}: short trip, day trip
- ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: trip, travel (general)
- ⟦{遠足|えんそく}→遠足：04107_ensoku⟧: excursion, field trip (school context)
